findings.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI remote code execution (Log4Shell)
findings.description: The Tomcat application bundles log4j-core 2.14.1. Attacker-controlled strings such as ${jndi:ldap://...} in logged headers lead to remote code execution.
findings.remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 or later; as a stop-gap remove JndiLookup.class and block outbound LDAP/RMI from the host.

findings.title: OpenSSH ssh-agent remote code execution via PKCS#11 providers
findings.description: OpenSSH before 9.3p2 ssh-agent can load attacker-controlled PKCS#11 libraries when agent forwarding is used.
findings.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.3p2 or later and avoid agent forwarding to untrusted hosts.

findings.title: SSH password authentication enabled
findings.description: Pentest confirmed the SSH daemon accepts password logins for local accounts, enabling online brute force.
findings.remediation: Set PasswordAuthentication no, use key-based auth with MFA, and deploy fail2ban.

findings.title: Microsoft SMBv1 remote code execution (MS17-010 / EternalBlue)
findings.description: The host is missing MS17-010 and exposes SMBv1, which is exploitable by EternalBlue for unauthenticated remote code execution.
findings.remediation: Apply MS17-010, disable SMBv1 and restrict 445/tcp to required hosts.

findings.title: Unsupported operating system (Windows Server 2008 R2 end of life)
findings.description: Windows Server 2008 R2 reached end of extended support and no longer receives security updates.
findings.remediation: Migrate file shares to a supported Windows Server release.

findings.title: Windows Print Spooler remote code execution (PrintNightmare)
findings.description: Print Spooler is running on the domain controller and is vulnerable to PrintNightmare, allowing SYSTEM code execution.
findings.remediation: Apply the July 2021 updates and disable the Print Spooler service on domain controllers.

findings.title: Google Chrome WebP heap buffer overflow
findings.description: Chrome 116 is installed; a crafted WebP image can cause heap corruption leading to code execution (exploited in the wild).
findings.remediation: Update Chrome to 116.0.5845.187 or later and enforce auto-update.

findings.title: Windows PowerShell 2.0 engine enabled
findings.description: PowerShell v2 lacks script block logging and AMSI, enabling downgrade attacks that evade detection.

findings.title: RDP without Network Level Authentication
findings.description: Remote Desktop accepts connections without NLA, exposing the logon screen to unauthenticated users and brute force.
findings.remediation: Require NLA, restrict RDP to the VPN/jump host and enable account lockout.
